text: HSE in design: safety-in-design reviews shall be held at the end of the basic design (constructability and maintainability, HS-RPT-0002) and at 60 % of the detailed design (3D model review) using the HSE-in-design register (HS-PLN-0001) with the actions closed before IFC; the occupational health and safety risk assessment (HS-RPT-0006) and the construction HSE plan (HS-PLN-0002) shall use the design hazards identified; the construction and environmental management plan shall follow HS-PLN-0003.
